description: An EXTENSION D_PDU of an unknown extended type is read to its header CRC, its EOT is used, and the sync search resumes after it, finding the next D_PDU.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). Every received D_PDU is a single-segment NON-ARQ-DATA (type 7, address size 4, C_PDU ID as stated, reception window 20) whose segment is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU from SAP 9 to SAP 9 with U_PDU "hi". At 2000: an EXTENSION (type 13, extended type 0x42, no extended header bytes) from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.9 with EOT 12 (end 8000); 12 unknown bytes that follow it; then a D_PDU from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.9 (C_PDU ID 1) with EOT 10 (end 7000). The EXTENSION is addressed to another node, so it would draw no WARNING (C-0735). The search resumes after its header CRC (C-0365) and finds the second D_PDU, so the estimate is 7000; a receiver that lost it would predict 8000. Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000 ms, then rule 3 gives 3000 ms.
